_meta.description: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every peptide in Apex. Every HTML page + the audit bot reads from here. Update this file ONLY — never duplicate data into individual HTML files.

schema.name: display name
schema.category: fatloss | gh-axis | recovery | longevity | cognitive | libido | trt | stack
schema.route: sc | im | sc/im | oral | spray | premixed
schema.vial_mg: default vial size in mg (or null if oral/spray/premixed)
schema.bac_ml: default bac water volume in mL (or null)
schema.dose_label: human-readable dose string (e.g. '300 mcg' or '1-2 mg')
schema.dose_range_mg: [min, max] research-backed per-injection range in mg
schema.warning: any compliance/chemistry warning (e.g. copper degrades TB-500)

bpc157.html.name: BPC-157
bpc157.html.mech: Body protective compound — gut-derived peptide for tissue repair
bpc157.html.research_note: Sikiric et al; tendon/ligament/gut healing 250-500 mcg/day
bpc157.html.recon_tip: Inject fasted, 30+ min before food for systemic effect (oral BPC works locally for gut, but SubQ near the injury site beats both for tendons/joints).
bpc157.html.timing_note: ⏰ Best 30+ min before food for systemic effect. SubQ near injury site beats both oral + far-from-site for tendons/joints.

cadence_flex.rule: 2x daily (AM + PM) doubles the area-under-curve and is preferred for acute injuries. 1x daily is fine for chronic/maintenance. Both well-tolerated.

tb500.html.name: TB-500
tb500.html.recon_tip: TB-500 takes 2-3 weeks to show effect — do NOT abandon it after week 1. Front-load with 5mg 2x/wk for the first 4 weeks (loading), then drop to 2.5mg 1-2x/wk maintenance.
tb500.html.timing_note: ⏰ 2x weekly, time of day flexible. No fasting requirement. Spreads loading dose across the week (Mon + Thu typical).

cadence_flex.rule: TB-500 has a long half-life (~7 days) — daily is biologically redundant and wasteful. Standard: load 2x/wk for 4-6 weeks, then maintenance 1x/wk. Don't go daily.

ghkcu.html.name: GHK-Cu
ghkcu.html.recon_tip: GHK-Cu turns the solution blue — that is the copper, totally normal. Do NOT mix in the same vial as TB-500: copper oxidizes TB-500 methionine and degrades it within ~7 days. Run them in separate bottles.
ghkcu.html.timing_note: ⏰ Time of day flexible. SubQ near target tissue (face/scalp for skin, near joint for repair). NOT in same vial as TB-500 (copper degrades it).

cadence_flex.rule: Daily preferred for skin/collagen results (steady copper-bound peptide signaling). 3x/wk works for systemic recovery. Either way: do NOT co-vial with TB-500 — copper degrades it.

kpv.html.name: KPV
kpv.html.timing_note: ⏰ Daily, time flexible. Anti-inflammatory + gut-supportive — split AM/PM helps if you have GI symptoms.

cadence_flex.rule: For systemic anti-inflammatory: 1x daily. For active gut/IBD focus: split 2x daily (AM/PM) at half the dose for steadier mucosal exposure. Same weekly total.

thymosin-alpha1.html.name: Thymosin α1

cadence_flex.rule: Standard immune-maintenance: 2x weekly @ 1.6mg = 3.2mg/wk. Daily low-dose (0.5mg) gives smoother coverage at the same weekly total. Daily acute (1.6mg/day × 7-14 days) is the clinical short-course used during active cold/flu/viral exposure — drop back to maintenance after.

thymosin-alpha1.html.timing_note: ⏰ Time of day flexible. Immune-modulating — best run Q1/Q4 during cold/flu season.

ara290.html.name: ARA-290
ara290.html.research_note: Brines et al; 4mg typical for neuropathy

epitalon.html.name: Epitalon
epitalon.html.recon_tip: Best taken at night — Epitalon works through the pineal axis and pairs with melatonin. 5-10mg/night × 10-20 day pulse, 1-2x per year.
epitalon.html.timing_note: ⏰ Pre-bed, every night × 10-20 days. Works through the pineal/melatonin axis — nighttime dosing is critical. 1-2x per year pulse.

ss31.html.name: SS-31
ss31.html.timing_note: ⏰ Morning, with food OK. Run AFTER MOTS-c (build new mitos first, then repair them). Order matters.

motsc.html.name: MOTS-c
motsc.html.research_note: Total weekly 5-10mg; substrate for biogenesis (run with NAD+)
motsc.html.recon_tip: MOTS-c needs NAD+ as a substrate. Load NAD+ for 2-4 weeks BEFORE starting MOTS-c, then run MOTS-c with NAD+ maintenance 1x/wk.
motsc.html.timing_note: ⏰ Morning, with light meal OK. Pairs well with cardio (potentiates exercise-induced AMPK signaling). Pairs with cardio + load NAD+ for 2-4 wks BEFORE starting MOTS-c.

cadence_flex.rule: MOTS-c is weekly-total dose-driven, not frequency-driven. Same weekly mg = same effect. Daily is fine at 1 mg/dose if you prefer smoother baseline or want to time it post-workout. ❌ NEVER daily at 3 mg — that's 21 mg/wk, 2-3× over target.

fox04-dri.html.name: FOX04-DRI
fox04-dri.html.research_note: 5-day pulse; clears senescent cells before rebuilding
fox04-dri.html.recon_tip: Senolytic — clears senescent cells. Run BEFORE Epitalon if you are stacking both. Order: FOX04 5-day pulse → 4-week wash → Epitalon. Otherwise you extend the lifespan of cells you should be clearing.
fox04-dri.html.timing_note: ⏰ Time flexible · 5-day pulse only. Senolytic clears senescent cells. Run BEFORE Epitalon if stacking. 1-2x per year max.

aod9604.html.name: AOD-9604
aod9604.html.mech: GH fragment 176-191 — lipolysis without GH effects
aod9604.html.recon_tip: AOD-9604 reconstitutes with 1 mL of 0.6% ACETIC ACID, NOT plain bacteriostatic water. The peptide is acid-stabilized — using BAC water alone causes faster degradation. Add the BAC water on top after the acetic acid for the rest of your volume.
aod9604.html.timing_note: ⏰ Fasted AM (within 30 min of waking, before workout). Insulin blocks lipolysis — keep fasted at least 1 hr after injection.

retatrutide.html.name: Retatrutide
retatrutide.html.research_note: Titrate 2→4→8→12mg weekly; Phase 2 trials weekly only
retatrutide.html.recon_tip: Titrate slowly to avoid GI hammer. Reta is the most aggressive of the GLP-1s — start at 2mg/wk, hold each step 4 weeks before bumping. Skip a week if nausea is severe.
retatrutide.html.timing_note: ⏰ Weekly, same day each week. Most users do Sunday PM with dinner. Skip a week if GI symptoms severe — restart at lower dose.

semaglutide.html.name: Semaglutide
semaglutide.html.recon_tip: Refrigerate after mixing. Reusing the same syringe across multiple injections from the same vial is fine — just keep the vial cold and the seal intact.
semaglutide.html.timing_note: ⏰ Weekly, same day each week. Time of day flexible. Refrigerate after mixing.

tirzepatide.html.name: Tirzepatide
tirzepatide.html.recon_tip: Tirz titration: 2.5 → 5 → 7.5 → 10 → 12.5 → 15 mg, hold each step 4 weeks. The GIP component reduces appetite faster than Sema — most users plateau at 10 mg.
tirzepatide.html.timing_note: ⏰ Weekly, same day each week. Time of day flexible. The GIP component reduces appetite faster than Sema.

5amino1mq.html.name: 5-Amino-1MQ
5amino1mq.html.mech: NNMT inhibitor — restores NAD+ + reduces methyl trap
5amino1mq.html.timing_note: ⏰ Daily, with or without food. NNMT inhibitor — works best paired with caloric deficit + resistance training.

tesamorelin.html.name: Tesamorelin
tesamorelin.html.mech: Stabilized GHRH analog — visceral fat reduction (FDA-approved HIV-LD)
tesamorelin.html.timing_note: ⏰ Pre-bed, fasted 2+ hrs after dinner. Insulin blocks the GH pulse Tesa is trying to trigger. On a GLP-1? Switch to AM, fully fasted overnight, eat 30-60 min AFTER injection.

cjc-no-dac.html.name: CJC-1295 (no DAC)
cjc-no-dac.html.timing_note: ⏰ Pre-bed, empty stomach. Most users add a 2nd shot pre-workout. On a GLP-1? AM only, fully fasted overnight.

cjc1295-dac.html.name: CJC-1295 (DAC)
cjc1295-dac.html.mech: GHRH analog with DAC — extended half-life
cjc1295-dac.html.timing_note: ⏰ Pre-bed, empty stomach. Last meal 2+ hrs before. On a GLP-1? AM only, fully fasted, food 30-60 min after.

ipamorelin.html.name: Ipamorelin
ipamorelin.html.timing_note: ⏰ Pre-bed, empty stomach. Pairs with CJC for synergy. On a GLP-1? AM only, fully fasted, food 30-60 min after.

cadence_flex.rule: Pulses GH each injection. More frequent = more pulses but higher tolerance build. 1x pre-bed is the cleanest signal. Add 2nd dose post-workout for hypertrophy phase. 3x is borderline overtraining the ghrelin receptor.

sermorelin.html.name: Sermorelin
sermorelin.html.timing_note: ⏰ Pre-bed, empty stomach. Wait 2+ hrs after last meal. On a GLP-1? AM only, fully fasted overnight.

cjc-ipa-blend.html.name: CJC + Ipa Blend
cjc-ipa-blend.html.timing_note: ⏰ Pre-bed, empty stomach. One shot for both GHRH + GHRP synergy. On a GLP-1? AM only, fully fasted, food 30-60 min after.

igf1-lr3.html.name: IGF-1 LR3
igf1-lr3.html.timing_note: ⏰ Post-workout window (within 30 min). Some users add a 2nd dose pre-bed. Site-specific injection possible (research only).

nad-plus.html.name: NAD+
nad-plus.html.timing_note: ⏰ Morning, with or without food. Loading 2-3x/wk × 4 wks then 1x/wk maintenance. Some users get flushing — split doses help.

options.pattern: 3x weekly Mon · Wed · Fri (67 mg each)

cadence_flex.rule: NAD+ is weekly-total-driven, not per-dose. Same weekly mg = same effect. More frequent = smoother substrate availability + less flushing per shot. Loading phase uses ~200 mg/wk × 4 weeks; maintenance drops to 100 mg/wk.

glutathione.html.name: Glutathione
glutathione.html.timing_note: ⏰ 2-3x weekly, morning preferred. Pairs with NAD+ as a longevity foundation. Push slowly — too fast can cause flushing.

cadence_flex.rule: Total weekly dose drives the antioxidant effect, not frequency. Daily at 200 mg/dose = same total as 2-3x/wk at 400 mg. Push slowly either way (too fast IV/SubQ = sulfur taste, mild flushing).

selank.html.name: Selank
selank.html.recon_tip: INTRANASAL — do NOT inject. 10 mg vial + 6 mL BAC → reconstitute directly into a nasal spray bottle (not a vial). Pumps deliver ~100 µL = ~167 mcg/spray. Standard dose: 1 spray per nostril, 2-3x daily. Refrigerate 2-8°C, light-protected, 14-21 day shelf.
selank.html.research_note: Intranasal; alternate with Semax to avoid tolerance

semax.html.name: Semax
semax.html.recon_tip: INTRANASAL — do NOT inject. 10 mg vial + 6 mL BAC → reconstitute directly into a nasal spray bottle (not a vial). Pumps deliver ~100 µL = ~167 mcg/spray. Standard dose: 1-2 sprays per nostril, 1-2x daily (morning + early afternoon — avoid late-day, can be stimulating). Refrigerate 2-8°C, light-protected, 14-21 day shelf.

pt141.html.name: PT-141
pt141.html.recon_tip: Inject 45 minutes before activity. PT-141 can cause flushing + nausea on first use — start at 1mg, scale to 2mg if tolerated. Do NOT take with stimulants.
pt141.html.timing_note: ⏰ 45 min before activity. On-demand only — no daily cycling. Avoid stimulants same day. Start at 1mg, scale to 2mg if tolerated.

slu-pp-322.html.name: SLU-PP-332
slu-pp-322.html.recon_tip: 5 mg vial + 2 mL BAC → 2,500 mcg/mL · 500 mcg = 20u on U-100 · refrigerate 2-8°C, light-protected. NOTE: Published murine studies used IP route only; SubQ in humans is not formally validated — research compound.
slu-pp-322.html.research_note: ERRα agonist exercise-mimetic · injectable research compound · 500mcg-1mg 3-5x/wk · SubQ not formally validated

wolverine.html.name: Wolverine Stack
wolverine.html.mech: BPC-157 5mg + TB-500 5mg combined in ONE vial
wolverine.html.research_note: No copper conflict — chemically stable combined

klow.html.name: KLOW Stack
klow.html.mech: KPV + TB-500 + BPC-157 + GHK-Cu combined in ONE vial
klow.html.warning: GHK-Cu copper degrades TB-500 — mix fresh weekly or run separate bottles
klow.html.recon_tip: ⚠️ KLOW combo bottle has GHK-Cu copper degrading TB-500. Mix fresh weekly and use within 7 days, OR run as separate vials.

glow.html.name: GLOW Stack
glow.html.mech: GHK-Cu + TB-500 + BPC-157 combined in ONE vial
glow.html.warning: GHK-Cu copper degrades TB-500 — mix fresh weekly or run separate bottles
glow.html.recon_tip: ⚠️ GLOW combo bottle has GHK-Cu copper degrading TB-500. Mix fresh weekly and use within 7 days, OR run as separate vials.

mito-reset.html.name: Mito Reset
mito-reset.html.research_note: Multi-bottle — separate vials. Sequence: NAD+ → MOTS-c → SS-31
